title: This Is Your Doge, If It Please You: Exploring Deception and Robustness in Mixture of LLMs
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical robustness and safety of multi-agent LLM systems against deceptive agents. While deception is an ethical concept, the study focuses on task-based performance (e.g., intentionally providing incorrect answers on multiple-choice questions) as a security vulnerability rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or societal values.
